notes: The more-options menu on the player now opens the actions for the song on the screen instead of the last song in the download queue, so a song played straight from the catalogue offers Crop a clip right where you are already looking at it.
Cropping a song played straight from the catalogue saves the part you keep into your library as its own song, cover and all, and leaves the song it came off exactly as it was.
The same menu carries Play, Add to a playlist and Add to an album for that song, and it no longer answers that nothing is playing while that song is on the bar.
